The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7261a742d7ca883), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 42-43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is δ1 > 0, depending only on the fixed group and the uniform quasi-isometry bounds, with the following property. Fix 0 < δ ≤ δ1. Let F, x, and the 42 following suffixes and steps vary with r: a ∼ 1Br(C) vol Br(C) dn, n = ak0, k0 ∈ Br((1 + δ)C, eo(r) ), k = exp(tXi), |t| ≤ e(1+δ)rsi(C)+o(r) . The suffix and step are deterministic. Every pair in the support of a limiting joint law of (fr,x,n, fr,x,nk) has the form (Aπz + b1, Aπz + b2) (z ∈ Uδ) for a common A ∈ A and some b1, b2 ∈ W.
